measures.title: St. Clair County: mayors in the Employees' Retirement System (Act 2026-61)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 relating to St. Clair County. It would allow mayors to participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama under certain conditions.
measures.yesMeans: Mayors in St. Clair County could participate in the Employees' Retirement System of Alabama under certain conditions.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this authorization for mayors is not added.
